rewards.name: Globe
rewards.description: The Earth, turning: real continents, day and night, a glowing atmosphere.

rewards.name: Radar Dish
rewards.description: A radar scope: bearing marks, a fading sweep, and contacts that flare as it passes.

rewards.name: Compass Rose
rewards.description: A compass bezel with a needle that swings and settles north.

rewards.name: Phases
rewards.description: The Moon through its phases, with craters, seas and earthshine.

rewards.name: Reactor Core
rewards.description: A glowing core inside three turning rings.

rewards.name: Ringed World
rewards.description: A banded gas giant, its ring with a gap and its shadow, and a moon going round.

rewards.name: The Watcher
rewards.description: An eye with a detailed iris that looks around, and blinks.

rewards.name: Black Sun
rewards.description: A dark sphere inside a flaring corona.

rewards.name: Golden Globe
rewards.description: The Earth in gold, with a sparkle. For legends only.

rewards.name: Galaxy
rewards.description: A spiral galaxy, turning slowly, with a bright core.

rewards.name: Aurora
rewards.description: The night side of the Earth: city lights below, curtains of light over the pole.

rewards.name: Atom
rewards.description: A nucleus with three electrons racing round it.

rewards.name: Black Hole
rewards.description: An accretion disc bent round a black hole by its gravity, with a photon ring.

rewards.name: Supernova
rewards.description: A star exploding, over and over. The rarest of all.

rewards.name: Terrarium
rewards.description: A tiny living world of soil, leaves and warm daylight.

rewards.name: Beacon
rewards.description: A rotating light sweeps through a layered signal sphere.

rewards.name: Wayfinder
rewards.description: A luminous route winds across a shaded globe.

rewards.name: Constellation
rewards.description: An orbiting field of stars connected into a living map.

rewards.name: Hearth Ember
rewards.description: A warm living ember inside a shelter of turning ash.

rewards.name: Glasshouse
rewards.description: A tiny glass world with growing leaves and a breathing lantern.

rewards.name: Stormglass
rewards.description: A storm sealed in glass, with lightning following the old weather route.

rewards.name: Sun Array
rewards.description: Eight bright panels around a solar core that tracks the light.

rewards.name: The Outpost
rewards.description: A miniature settlement under stars, with eight glowing camp lights.

rewards.name: No title
rewards.description: Just your name.

rewards.name: Steady
rewards.description: Your name as it is.

rewards.name: Glow
rewards.description: Your name glows softly.

rewards.name: Static
rewards.description: Your name flickers now and then, like a bad signal.

rewards.name: Scanline
rewards.description: A light sweeps across your name.

rewards.name: Gold
rewards.description: Your name in gold.

rewards.name: Anvil Spark
rewards.description: A forge-lit anvil throwing sparks in a slow orbit.

rewards.name: Signal Tower
rewards.description: A lattice mast in the dark, sending rings into the night.

rewards.name: Companion Lantern
rewards.description: A warm lantern with small lights gathered around it.

rewards.name: Warden Core
rewards.description: The north's old machine heart, humming red.
